verdict.rationale: Framer's own AI agents can act on many items at once. The CMS agent sets up and updates the entire CMS, including a demonstrated CSV import of 39 linked rows. The design agent applies colors, fonts and styles across the whole site, and external agents can create, update and delete CMS items. Missing for 10: a documented explicit bulk-edit/batch API or multi-select operation with stated scale limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that bulk changes work reliably at volume.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The CMS agent sets up, organizes, and updates your entire CMS, connecting it directly to the canvas so content and design stay in sync.
Added two linked collections: 1. Articles — 39 CSV rows imported. 2. Categories — 10 rows added and linked to Articles as multi-select tags.
The agent takes care of colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects across your site.
Once connected, the agent can read and write CMS collections, including creating, updating, and deleting items.
